paper: Align, Don't Blend: Orthogonal Supervision Disentanglement As the Key to Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection (Chen et al., ACM MM 2026, arXiv 2512.06746 v3)
training_set_in_paper: Not trained in SynthScope. The full method as released: the official VLM adapter (adb_vlm: Gaffeyzz/Align-Dont-Blend-VLM @ 49975ccd on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct @ cc594898, greedy, bf16, the request of predict.py @ cf168db: the task prompt as the user message, repetition penalty 1.0, max 1,210,000 pixels, an unparsed answer Real) OR the official pixel expert (the released DDA checkpoint DDA_ckpt.pth = dda.pth; the authors confirmed DDA is the expert, 2026-11-20), with the official rule of predict.py (GzZning/Align-Dont-Blend @ cf168db): fake if the VLM's verdict is AI-generated or DDA P(fake) >= 0.5. GenImage and AIGCDetect fakes JPEG q96 in memory (the official tools/jpeg96.py). Per image, adb_vlm records (job 301129, RTX A5000) are fused with dda records on the same files (repro/adb_full/fuse.py); every row is in repro/adb_full/paper_comparison.json and repro/adb_full/results/. Balanced accuracy, mean over the paper's subsets.

benchmarks.name: WildRF (Facebook, Reddit, Twitter test sets), full data, 2,503 images
benchmarks.metric: balanced accuracy per platform, and their mean

our_number.note: Full data, VLM bf16 greedy on RTX A5000 (the cf168db request) OR dda: 93.01 balanced acc [bootstrap 95% CI 91.87, 94.17] (facebook 93.44 / reddit 92.2 / twitter 93.4), AUROC 99.47 (+0.11 vs the paper; Twitter -2.10). VLM alone 95.96, DDA alone 90.2. With the earlier request (upstream f4b4794): 91.22; the paired change is +1.79 [0.98, 2.65].

benchmarks.name: BFree-Online, all held images (269 real + 538 fake still online of the 1,111 listed)

our_number.note: 807 of the paper's 1,111 images (the rest are offline): 96.84 balanced acc [95.44, 98.05], AUROC 99.41 (-0.66); VLM alone 81.69, DDA alone 94.98; VLM bf16 on RTX A5000, the cf168db request. Earlier request: 96.93 (paired change -0.09 [-1.02, 0.84]). Not the paper's full set, so reference.

benchmarks.name: AIGI-Bench CommunityAI + SocialRF, full data (12,000 + 6,000 images)
benchmarks.metric: balanced accuracy per subset, and their mean

our_number.note: Full data (18,000), VLM bf16 on RTX A5000, the cf168db request: 89.22 balanced acc [88.75, 89.69] (CommunityAI 92.75 / SocialRF 85.68), AUROC 98.03 (+0.42); VLM alone 88.81, DDA alone 83.18. 96 VLM answers unparsed (Real, as predict.py). On the earlier 9,000-image selection (SocialRF full + CommunityAI first 1,500 + 1,500): 89.49, vs 87.52 with the earlier request (paired change +1.97 [1.50, 2.47]).
